thread:
Anya G: Quick sync — I ran the scheduler pooling sweep across us-east, eu-west, and ap-south for the new 13B quant build. Posting raw notes + a couple surprising bits.
Sam T: awesome, drop the numbers.
Anya G: TL;DR: H100 (us-east) still wins p50/p95, but throughput per-GPU on G8 (eu-west) was ~1.15x for token-heavy short prompts when pool-size=4 and window=25ms.
Leon R: interesting. pool-size=4 + 25ms is what we use in staging, right? any variance with max_batch_tokens?
Anya G: yep staging uses 4/25/1024. I swept max_batch_tokens=[512,1024,2048]. On H100 p99 gets worse at 2048 for long prompts — tail spikes. G8 maintained smoother tails but lower absolute p50.
Kevin P: did you try quant variants? int8 vs int4?
Anya G: ran three quant modes: fp16 baseline, int8 (symmetric), and hybrid-int4 (outlier channels preserved fp16). hybrid-int4 saved 38% memory and increased effective batch depth on node, but had a tiny quality regression on long-form instruction completions (coherence drops ~0.6 BLEU-ish metric on our eval set).
Zara M: can you paste the perf table? even a tiny snippet.
Anya G: sure — pasted below (raw):
```
region,gpu,window_ms,pool_size,max_batch_tokens,quant,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,throughput_tok/s
us-east,H100,10,2,1024,fp16,48,120,220,16500
us-east,H100,25,4,1024,int8,52,130,310,21000
eu-west,G8,25,4,1024,hybrid-int4,67,180,260,19000
ap-south,G8,50,6,2048,hybrid-int4,85,240,430,21000
```
Sam T: hmm p99 on us-east int8 jumped to 310 vs fp16 220. kernel choice? which matmul path used?
Anya G: the runtime picked kernel_set=v2_fused for int8 on H100; for hybrid-int4 it used fallback mixed-kernel (some aten kernels). I suspect int8 path has instability for long sequences we didn't capture in microbench.
Leon R: any logs for cache-eviction or KV thrashing? could be prefix cache pressure at 2048 tokens.
Anya G: saw KV cache evictions on H100 at high concurrency — bench-bot captured a few GC spikes aligning with p99. I attached a sample stacklog line in the next message.
bench-bot: attach stacklog 2360004323 -- gc_pause_ms=34,kv_evictions=7,concurrent_requests=48
Kevin P: can you repro with kernel forced? try forcing matmul=gnn-fused and matmul=classic for int8 path to see diff. Also try window=15ms as intermediate.
Anya G: queued two runs: force=int8-gnn-fused @ us-east/H100 and force=classic-int8 @ us-east/H100, window sweep [15,25], pool_size [3,4]. ETA ~45m.
Zara M: on the quality side, where did hybrid-int4 degrade? which evals?
Anya G: primarily long-dialog coherency and code-gen multi-line tests. Single-turn QA is fine. A quick metric: rouge-l drop ~0.8 on multi-turn set. Might be quantizing attention score tails.
Sam T: if hybrid-int4 gives good throughput but small quality hit, consider routing long requests to fp16 model variant and short to hybrid-int4. Do we have routing logic by token-length in scheduler?
Leon R: no policy yet, but we can add simple prefix: if expected_max_tokens>1500 route to fp16 pool. cheap rule.
Kevin P: watch cost impact. routing could blow reserved capacity usage on H100. Maybe a fallback: if pool utilization <70% route long to fp16, else queue to hybrid.
Anya G: noted. I'll include utilization-aware routing in the next experiment and add a metric for committed GPU-hours.
bench-bot: scheduled run 2360004400 (force kernels + routing heuristic)
Zara M: thanks — can you also dump sample outputs for the eval prompts where rouge dropped? need to inspect failure modes before we decide to roll.
Anya G: will attach diffs after runs. For now, action items: 1) Kevin/Leon: help with forced-kernel runs and double-check matmul perf counters. 2) Sam: help draft routing rule (len>1500 -> fp16 if util<70%). 3) Me: run utilization-aware sweep and produce a short table of p50/p95/p99 + quality delta.
Sam T: accepted.
Kevin P: on it.
Leon R: will monitor KV evictions logs.
Anya G: thanks, will post results in this thread when done. :rocket:
